x: In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful

قَادِرٍ رَّبِّـي قَدَّرَ قَضَآءً فَقَهْقَرَ أَقُوْلُ بَاقِرٌ قَارِمْعَ قَرْقُشٌ فِيْ قَيْقُوْشٍ م بِـحَقِّ قَلَانِسِ الْقُطْبِ الْقَمْقَامِ الْقَنَا مَنِّ فَقَرْقَرِىْ تَقْبَلُ بِقُبُوْلِ قُرْبٍ قَدَّسَ عَنِ الْقَرَامِ قَـيَا قَيُّوْمٍم بِقَوْقَمِهَا فِـيْ قَيْقَاتٍم بِقُفْقَفَةٍ فَقُفَقَةٍ فَقَهْرِ قِطَـاطِنْ وَقْسَمٍ فَقْنَةٌ يَّا قَوِّىُّ

Qādirin rabbī qaddara qaḍāʾan fa-qahqara. Aqūlu: Bāqirun, Qārimʿa, Qarqushun fī Qayqūshin. Bi-ḥaqqi qalānisi l-quṭbi l-qamqāmi l-qanā, manni fa-qarqarī. Taqbalu bi-qubūli qurbin, qaddasa ʿani l-qarām. Qa-yā Qayyūmu, bi-qawqamihā fī qayqātin, bi-qufqafatin fa-qufaqatin, fa-qahri Qiṭāṭin wa Qasamin, fa-qnatun. Yā Qawiyy.

My Lord is the All-Powerful; He decreed a decree and it drew back. I say: Bāqir, Qārimʿa, Qarqush within Qayqūsh. By the right of the caps of the Quṭb, the mighty one of the spears — a favour, so let it flow. Accept with the acceptance of nearness; He has sanctified beyond all reproach. So, O Self-Subsisting: by its qawqam within qayqāt, by qufqafa and then qufaqa, and by the subduing of Qiṭāṭ and Qasam — so let there be devotion. O Strong One.
